name: Y60 Smart Watch Ultra 7+1 Sports Edition | Full Touch Display Fitness Tracker
description:
The Y60 Smart Watch Ultra (7+1) combines fitness, style, and everyday functionality in one sleek wearable. Featuring a vibrant full-touch HD display, it helps you monitor heart rate, sleep, steps, and more while keeping you connected with smart notifications and music control. With long battery life, customizable straps, and compatibility with Android and iOS, it’s ideal for workouts, outdoor activities, and daily use.
Key Features
 7+1 health and fitness functions
 Full-touch HD display with smooth navigation
 Heart rate, sleep, and step monitoring
 Smart notifications and music control
 Long-lasting battery for all-day use
 Compatible with Android and iOS devices
Ingredients / Materials
Alloy body, Silicone straps, Electronic components
How to Use
 Fully charge the watch before first use
 Connect via the companion app on Android or iOS
 Customize watch face and straps to your style
 Track health, fitness, and notifications directly on your wrist
Package Includes
 1 × Y60 Smart Watch Ultra
 2 × Straps (7+1 Edition Includes Multiple Straps)
 1 × Magnetic Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
